about: Notes for the seeded store of scripts/seed.ts. `rewrites` say a fact of one seeded note again in other words: `original` is the id of that note. `unrelated` are new facts that no seeded note holds. `session` are two notes that an agent wrote in a headless /kb:checkpoint on this store: one is a twin of `original`, and one is a new fact. A repo is the folder name under repos/, or null for a global note.

rewrites.title: Staging DB is used by other teams: do not migrate it
rewrites.body:
Running migrate up on staging removed a column that another team needed.
Migrate a local copy, and let the user do the staging step.

rewrites.title: A rejected upload still gives exit code 0 from the deploy command
rewrites.body:
The deploy tool returns success even when the server refused the upload.
Look for status live in its JSON output before you report a deploy.

rewrites.title: Permission prompts time out in a background agent
rewrites.body:
An agent that runs in the background gets no answer to a prompt, so the call is denied.
Avoid rm in compound commands. Use mktemp directories and script files.

rewrites.title: Installs right after a publish can get the previous version
rewrites.body:
The registry mirror lags up to 60 minutes behind.
Pin the exact version, and pass --prefer-online.

rewrites.title: Do not rebase a branch that has an open PR
rewrites.body:
The review tool loses the anchors of its comments after a rebase.
Merge main into the PR branch instead.

rewrites.title: Money in atlas-api is stored as whole cents
rewrites.body:
Floating point in billing made totals wrong by a cent.
Keep integers inside, and convert only at the boundary.

rewrites.title: tidepool sync tests fail in random order without a database reset
rewrites.body: The test suites share a schema. Run make db-reset before each suite.

rewrites.title: quarry talks to the database with plain SQL
rewrites.body: We chose typed SQL helpers over an ORM, because the ORM concealed a slow query for weeks.

rewrites.title: How to ship a new ferry version
rewrites.body:
Run make check, raise the version number in package.json, and merge to main.
The build service does the deploy. Then look at the health endpoint for the new version.

rewrites.title: orchard dev server reports module not found when port 4100 is busy
rewrites.body: The error is misleading. Free the port and start the server again.

unrelated.title: git worktree prune removes the record of a worktree on an unmounted disk
unrelated.body: Mount the disk before you run prune, or the worktree must be added again.

unrelated.title: The JSON formatter reorders keys in lock files
unrelated.body: Exclude lock files from the format step. A reordered lock file makes a large diff with no change.

unrelated.title: Record a terminal session as a GIF
unrelated.body: Run the recorder with a fixed window size of 100 by 30, then convert the cast file with the gif tool at 2x speed.

unrelated.title: Fonts are self-hosted, not loaded from a CDN
unrelated.body: A third-party font host added 300 ms to the first paint and one more privacy notice.

unrelated.title: atlas-api invoice PDFs render in the server time zone
unrelated.body: A customer in Tokyo got an invoice dated the day before. Pass the customer's zone to the renderer.

unrelated.title: tidepool websocket clients reconnect in a storm after a deploy
unrelated.body: Every client reconnects at once. Add jitter of up to 30 seconds to the reconnect delay.

unrelated.title: lantern-web uses CSS container queries for the card grid
unrelated.body: Media queries could not see the sidebar width. Container queries removed three breakpoints.

unrelated.title: Profile a slow quarry indexing run
unrelated.body: Start it with the --cpu-prof flag, open the profile in the browser dev tools, and sort by self time.

unrelated.title: harbor-cli shell completions break when the binary is renamed
unrelated.body: The completion script holds the binary name. Generate it again after a rename.

unrelated.title: mosaic image uploads over 10 MB need the chunked endpoint
unrelated.body: The plain endpoint answers 413. Split the file into 5 MB parts and call /upload/chunk.

session.title: Preview deployments are deleted one week after they are made
session.body:
Hosting support said this on 2026-11-19. A preview link in an old PR description gives a 404.
Do not rely on a preview link as lasting evidence in a PR. Put screenshots, videos or test output in the PR itself.
Re-deploy the preview when a reviewer needs it after a week.
Source: hosting support, not checked by a test.

session.title: A Node version change does not rebuild native modules until CACHE_VERSION is raised
session.body:
The build cache key holds only the hash of the lockfile. Hosting support said this on 2026-11-19.
A change of the Node version alone keeps the old native modules, so a build can be broken or stale.
When the Node version changes, raise the CACHE_VERSION variable by hand, in the same PR or release step.
Source: hosting support, not checked by a test.
